types: extension Font.TextStyle (fileprivate) — defaultPointSizes table and nearest(toPointSize:)
state: static Font.TextStyle.defaultPointSizes (11 styles with HIG default sizes)

units.does: Applies ScaledSystemFont with the given size/weight/design/monospacedDigit and textStyle (explicit or nearest to size).

branches.effect: nil textStyle (all callers in this chunk): uses the style whose default size is closest to size.

flags.text: The relativeTo: parameter is never passed: none of the 249 .scaledFont( call sites in 69 files uses it (grep 'scaledFont(.*relativeTo' returns 0), so the explicit-style side of the ?? at line 62 is never taken and every caller gets .nearest(toPointSize:).

Applies Font.system(size: scaled size, weight, design), with .monospacedDigit() when requested.

units.does: Returns the text style whose default point size has minimum absolute difference to points (first match on ties, so 17 → .body), or .body if the table were empty.

branches.effect: fallback .body only when defaultPointSizes is empty, which never happens (11 constant entries).
